name: air_walker
text: Standing upright on an outdoor air walker holding its front rail. Keep torso steady, elbows down. Legs alternately swing gently forward and backward on the two pedals.

scene.text: Standing upright on an outdoor air walker holding its front rail. Keep torso steady, elbows down. Legs alternately swing gently forward and backward on the two pedals.
scene.description: Start at fitness_air_walker.post_airwalk facing the model standing marker direction. Standing upright on an outdoor air walker exercise machine, both hands hold a horizontal bar at chest height. Legs alternately swing forward and backward like pendulums, knees slightly bent, torso remains steady. Two slow cycles. LeftHand touches the physical model marker grip_left at 0.00s, 3.00s. RightHand touches the physical model marker grip_right at 0.00s, 3.00s. LeftFoot touches the physical model marker foot_left at 0.00s, 3.00s. RightFoot touches the physical model marker foot_right at 0.00s, 3.00s. Both hands are occupied at their corresponding contact points; the description defines their release. Keep soles on the corresponding pedals and torso between the handles; avoid the swinging arms with knees.
scene.idle_hand: Both hands are occupied at their corresponding contact points; the description defines their release.
scene.clearance: Keep soles on the corresponding pedals and torso between the handles; avoid the swinging arms with knees.

visual_review.method: Visual review only. Initial whole-duration chronological overview at 5 fps, followed by full 30 fps sequences and close-ups where needed. No numerical quality gates or tests. Real-time viewing unavailable; do not claim live playback.
visual_review.observation: Whole 0-2.967 s side sequence at 30 fps, full front overview and front 1-2 s full sequence: feet stay on rotating plates; upright body stays between supports; both hands stay on the front bar. Previous drifting/crouching candidates rejected.
visual_review.scope: The old assistant approval was withdrawn after missed activity and contact failures. Retained observations describe their historical scope and do not approve the current version.
